verdict.rationale: Treasury documents API-driven money movement as first-class objects: OutboundPayment for push transfers, inbound transfers for pulls, and ReceivedDebit objects for third-party debits. Every movement creates a ledger Transaction with a v2.money_management.transaction.created webhook, and returns appear among the platform-owned controls. However, none of the evidence names ACH, and the unhappy paths are barely modeled. Missing for 10: explicit ACH origination of credits and debits, same-day ACH windows, NOCs and reversals as first-class objects, return-specific objects and webhook events, independent hands-on corroboration.
